import { Element } from "../node_modules/.pnpm/@types_hast@3.0.4/node_modules/@types/hast/index.js";
import { CodeHeaderProps, ComponentsByLanguage, SyntaxHighlighterProps } from "../types.js";
import { ComponentPropsWithoutRef, ComponentType } from "react";

//#region src/adapters/code-adapter.d.ts
type CodeProps = ComponentPropsWithoutRef<"code"> & {
  node?: Element | undefined;
};
interface CodeAdapterOptions {
  SyntaxHighlighter?: ComponentType<SyntaxHighlighterProps> | undefined;
  CodeHeader?: ComponentType<CodeHeaderProps> | undefined;
  componentsByLanguage?: ComponentsByLanguage | undefined;
}
/**
 * Creates a code component adapter that bridges the assistant-ui
 * SyntaxHighlighter/CodeHeader API to streamdown's code component.
 */
declare function createCodeAdapter(options: CodeAdapterOptions): import("react").MemoExoticComponent<({
  node,
  className,
  children,
  "data-block": dataBlock,
  ...props
}: CodeProps & {
  "data-block"?: string;
}) => import("react").JSX.Element>;
/**
 * Checks if the code adapter should be used (i.e., user provided custom components).
 */
declare function shouldUseCodeAdapter(options: CodeAdapterOptions): boolean;
//#endregion
export { createCodeAdapter, shouldUseCodeAdapter };
